Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001135" [constraint]: The webhook dispatcher's deploy window is on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1001082" [constraint]: As of 2026-02-23, the scheduler's deploy window remains weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000944" [decision]: On 2025-12-17, Team Dune's standup decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write.  (about: Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000851": Team Boreal holds its planning meeting on Thursdays.  (about: Team Boreal)
- memory_id "1000829" [constraint]: The billing service has no deploys from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of the peak season.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000815" [constraint]: As of 2025-10-27, the scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000671": On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000516" [decision]: As of 2025-06-27, Team Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.  (about: Team Boreal)
- memory_id "1000478": As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal has taken over the catalog service from Team Dune.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000476": Dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed as of 2025-06-16.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000406": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the catalog service is not Team Boreal's service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000402" [constraint]: The billing service ships only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000365" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000327": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000273": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000266" [constraint]: The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000241" [constraint]: The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000186" [constraint]: The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000183" [constraint]: The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
Existing entity names: webhook dispatcher, scheduler, Team Dune, indexer, Team Boreal, billing service, Team Atlas, catalog service, ledger, webhooks service, reporting service, event bus, auth gateway
